## About
American Ghost Adventures is Central Florida's longest-running ghost tour agency, locally owned and operated out of Pine Street in Orlando. Founder and lead investigator Ting leads tours alongside Kathy, Debbie, Melanie, Beau, Emilio, Jason and Madison.
You won't find costumed actors or staged jump scares here. Our investigators bring you into haunted partner venues with real equipment, and you may just run into shadow figures, moving objects or something you can't explain. We can't promise the ghosts will show up, though. They're not on the payroll.
Guests rate us 4.9 from 814 Google reviews, and they tend to mention their guide by name. Come with an open mind and let us show you that Orlando is much more than a "mouse house".

## Services
- Orlando Ghost Tours: Investigate Orlando's haunted buildings and learn the city's history along the way.
- Investigative Ghost Tours: Go inside haunted buildings with real paranormal equipment and try to communicate with the spirits there.
- Mount Dora Ghost Tour: An evening through beautiful downtown Mount Dora and the town's haunted history.
- Deland tour: Come along with Kathy to learn more about what may or may not still be out there in Deland.
- Winter Garden, New Smyrna Beach and Sanford ghost tours: Investigative ghost tours in more Central Florida towns.

## FAQ
Q: Will we see a ghost?
A: No promises. Sightings and direct phenomena don't happen on every investigation. We work with the paranormal, but the ghosts aren't on the payroll.

Q: Can I bring my kids?
A: Tours are family friendly, but parents know their children best. Their maturity level is the key factor in deciding whether they should come along.

Q: I've never done anything like this. Is that okay?
A: Yes. We accommodate every level, from seasoned ghost hunters to first-time novices.

Q: How do I make a reservation?
A: Call us at 407-256-6225 or email americanghostadventures@gmail.com. We're open every day.

Q: How can I pay at the gift shop?
A: One reviewer noted the gift shop doesn't take cards for merchandise. Cash, Cash App, Venmo, Paypal and Zelle are accepted.
